description:
You are using the Flight Crew View app and need to file a support ticket about a sync issue. Before contacting support, you need to gather the app's version number and the developer's contact email.

Starting from the Friends page (home screen), navigate to the app's Settings, then find the About or App Info section. Locate:
1. The app version number (as displayed on screen)
2. The developer's contact email address

Save both pieces of information to a plain text file at /sdcard/app_info_report.txt in exactly this format:

App Version: <version string as displayed>
Developer Email: <email address as displayed>

Replace the angle-bracket placeholders with the actual values you find in the app. The file must contain exactly these two labeled lines.
